newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Universum seeks to open fund.
newsitem.headline: Czech Universum seeks to open fund.

text.p: Czech fund manager IKS KB a.s. said on Tuesday that it filed a request with the Finance Ministry to transfer its Universum closed-end unit trust into an open-end fund.

"The board of Investicni Kapitalova Spolecnost KB agreed (on Monday) to accelerate the process of tranferring the closed unit fund Universum into an open-end unit fund...with the aim of realising the transfer in September this year," the firm said in a statement.
It said the step would allow shareholders of the fund "in a short time period" to sell their units to IKS KB at a price "higher" than the listed price on the Prague Stock Exchange.
Under Czech securities laws, any fund manager seeking to transform the fund's status must offer to buy shares from current shareholders at a price equal to the fund's net asset value per share.
IKS KB said Universum has been trading recently at a discount of 20 to 30 percent below its net asset value.
Universum shares closed Tuesday down 37 crowns at 719 crowns.
IKS KB said it applied on Tuesday with the Prague Stock Exchange to temporarily halt trading in Universum shares "to limit speculation" in the units.
